proposals.proposedStatement: Inspect existing codebase and reuse proven local implementations before introducing new helpers.
proposals.rationale: Universal engineering hygiene rule. Reduces duplication and maintenance drag without imposing framework or styling constraints.

proposals.proposedStatement: Prefer standard library capabilities over external third-party dependencies; never import a package for a few lines of code.
proposals.rationale: Core dependency hygiene principle. Reduces supply-chain attack surface and build bloat.

proposals.proposedStatement: Leverage native platform features before layering custom emulation or heavy abstraction frameworks.
proposals.rationale: Fundamental software architecture principle. Ensures performance and accessibility out of the box.

proposals.proposedStatement: Implement the minimal verified code that works; avoid speculative scaffolding for hypothetical future needs.
proposals.rationale: Occam engineering principle. Eliminates dead code, speculative wrappers, and configuration bloat.

proposals.proposedStatement: No unrequested abstractions: no interface with one implementation, no factory for one product.
proposals.rationale: Fails universal globalization test because testability around external seams requires single-implementation interfaces. Restored as contextual rule CANON-CTX-001.

proposals.proposedStatement: Can it be one line?: One line.
proposals.rationale: Extreme brevity heuristic is harmful in safety-critical, audited, or multi-developer team environments. Demoted from global status.

proposals.proposedStatement: Never use gradients or blur; maintain flat border-separated surfaces.
proposals.rationale: Aesthetic grammar rule cannot be globalized. Assigned exclusively to PROFILE-DESIGN-001.

proposals.proposedStatement: All UI-bound observable view models must be isolated on @MainActor.
proposals.rationale: Platform-specific language feature. Assigned to PROFILE-PLAT-002.

proposals.proposedStatement: Mandatory: read the workflow markdown file before executing any task.
proposals.rationale: Procedural workflow command specification. Assigned to PROFILE-WORK-001.

claimStrengthCalibration.overclaimIdentified: SA3 summary documentation claimed surviving global rules were genuinely universal or universal truths.
claimStrengthCalibration.calibratedStandard: In formal engineering epistemology, surviving rules have NOT been proven universally true across all possible domains; they have SURVIVED_DEFINED_FALSIFICATION_SET (no counterexample found within the defined test cases). Authoritative wording must strictly use SURVIVED_DEFINED_FALSIFICATION_SET.
